hero.title: From bramble to
hero.lede: We design it, build it and look after it: patios, paths, lawns and planting, with one team from the first visit to the first summer. Scroll and watch a back garden made over.

stages.c: We walk it with you, measure every edge and note what stays: the apple tree, the light, where the sun sets.
Brambles out by the root, rubble and the old pallets gone, the ground levelled and ready.
Sandstone patio laid on a full bed, a stepping-stone path to the bench, oak sleepers for the borders.
Topsoil raked level, then fresh turf rolled out the same morning it was cut.
Roses, lavender and salvias in the borders, a new acer by the fence, pots by the door.
First summer: the borders full, the lawn thick, and the path lit for warm evenings.

quote.title: A rough price before we visit.
quote.sub: Tell us how big your garden is and what you'd like. It's a guide, not a quote: we fix the price after the free visit, in writing.

size.hint: A tennis court is about 260 m²

quote.note: Includes clearing, materials, waste and VAT. Your fixed price comes after the visit, and it doesn't change once we start.

care.title: Looked after, month by month.
care.sub: After the build, we keep it the way it was meant to be. Pick a month to see what we do on our visits.

months.name: January
months.line: Quiet in the borders, busy underground.

jobs.s: Apple and pear trees shaped while they sleep.
Leaves off the lawn, fences and paths checked after storms.

months.name: February
months.line: The first bulbs show. Time to get ahead.

jobs.s: Grasses and last year's perennials cut to the ground.
Pruned hard to an outward bud and mulched.
On a high cut, edges trimmed sharp.
Borders fed and mulched before the weeds start.
Crowded perennials lifted and split.
Spring feed and moss treatment, bare patches seeded.
Borders weeded by hand while the roots are shallow.
Peony and delphinium supports in before they need them.

months.name: May
months.line: The borders fill out week by week.

jobs.s: Every visit, with edges and paths swept.
Summer pots and gaps in the borders planted.
A first light trim once the birds have finished nesting.

months.name: June
months.line: Long evenings. The garden at its best.

jobs.s: Roses and perennials deadheaded to keep them flowering.
New planting and pots watered deeply, not often.
Higher cut in dry spells to keep the lawn green.

months.name: July
months.line: Keeping it going through the heat.

jobs.s: Pots fed weekly, borders watered in dry weeks.
Lavender cut back after flowering, box clipped.

months.name: August
months.line: Late colour, and the first seeds.

jobs.s: The main hedge cut, clean and square.
Dahlias and salvias kept flowering into autumn.
Scarified, aerated and overseeded.
Shrubs and perennials planted while the soil is warm.
Spring bulbs ordered and the first ones in.
Cleared from lawns and paths, left under hedges for wildlife.
Planted deep in pots and borders.
Final cut and the mower serviced.
Tender plants wrapped, pots raised on feet.
Storm damage, ties and stakes checked.
A walk round together to plan next year.

plans.s: One visit a month: the big jobs, done at the right time.
Lawn, borders and hedges kept in shape all year.
Weekly May to August, fortnightly the rest of the year.

book.title: Walk the garden with us.
book.sub: An hour in your garden with a designer, free and with no obligation. Pick a day and we'll confirm a time by text.

steps.s: An hour in your garden: what you love, what you don't, how you use it.

steps.b: A design and a fixed price
steps.s: Drawings and a written price within two weeks.
One team from start to finish, the garden left tidy every night.

book.note: We cover Guildford, Woking and the villages around them.

footer.fine: Verge Gardens is a made-up business for a concept site.
